The asserted boundary of the triangular bipyramid has only nine edges. In the explicitly claimed representative W={0,1,2,3,7}, the six transitive triangles are 013,017,023,027,137,237 and use all edges except {1,2}; that extra edge is a loop chord between bipyramid apices. Thus K[W] is a bipyramid S² with one attached apex-apex 1-cell, homotopy equivalent to S² ∨ S¹, not a sphere. This contradicts repeated literal "every corresponding induced complex is the boundary" and face count (5,9,6).
